short_description: GlobalProtect VPN: error 809 / unable to establish connection
text:
Symptom

The VPN client shows 'Error 809' or 'Gateway unreachable'.

Cause

UDP ports 500/4500 blocked by the home/hotel network, or an outdated VPN profile.

Resolution

  1. Check that the Internet connection works without VPN.
  2. In GlobalProtect: Settings > Refresh portal.
  3. If it persists, switch to the SSL gateway 'vpn-ssl.corp.local' (port 443).
  4. Restart the 'PanGPS' service (services.msc).
  5. If the error remains, collect logs (Settings > Troubleshooting > Collect logs) and assign to the Network Team.

short_description: Outlook stuck on 'Loading profile' or keeps prompting for password
text:
Symptom

Outlook hangs on 'Loading profile' or asks for the password in a loop.

Resolution

  1. Close Outlook, open Windows Credential Manager and remove the 'MicrosoftOffice16_Data' entries.
  2. Start 'outlook.exe /safe' to rule out faulty add-ins.
  3. If safe mode works, disable add-ins from File > Options > Add-ins.
  4. Last resort: Control Panel > Mail > create a new profile.

short_description: Active Directory account locked out after password change
text:
Symptom

The user gets locked out several times a day after changing their password.

Cause

Old credentials stored on a smartphone (corporate mail), mapped drives or Credential Manager.

Resolution

  1. Unlock the account from ADUC or the self-service portal.
  2. Have the user update the password on their phone (Outlook/Mail app) and on corporate Wi-Fi.
  3. Clear Windows Credential Manager.
  4. If it continues, use 'LockoutStatus.exe' to identify the DC and the lockout source.

Users can reset their password at https://passwordreset.corp.local with MFA. If MFA is not registered, the agent must verify the user's identity (employee ID + manager) and force a reset from ADUC with 'User must change password at next logon'.

short_description: Network printer: jobs stuck in queue / 'Error - Printing'
text:
Resolution

  1. On the PC: services.msc > stop 'Print Spooler'.
  2. Delete the contents of C:\Windows\System32\spool\PRINTERS.
  3. Restart the Spooler.
  4. If the queue is on print server PRT01, ask the Workplace Team to clear the central queue.
  5. Check that the printer responds to ping on its IP address.

short_description: SAP GUI: 'Partner not reached' / cannot connect to server
text:
Cause

Wrong system entry in SAP Logon, or VPN not connected.

Resolution

  1. Make sure the VPN is connected (if remote).
  2. Refresh SAPUILandscape.xml from \\fileserver\sap\config.
  3. Test with 'telnet sapprd.corp.local 3200'.
  4. If the port does not respond, open an incident for the SAP Basis Team.

short_description: C: drive full / low disk space on laptop
text:
Resolution

  1. Run 'cleanmgr' and select 'Clean up system files'.
  2. Empty %TEMP% and the Downloads folder.
  3. Make sure OneDrive is set to 'Files On-Demand'.
  4. Use WinDirStat to find unusual folders (e.g. Outlook .ost > 20GB).
  5. If the disk is < 256GB and the user is a developer, suggest a hardware upgrade request.

short_description: Microsoft Teams: audio/video not working during meetings
text:
Resolution

  1. Teams > Settings > Devices: select the correct headset/microphone.
  2. Windows privacy settings: allow access to camera and microphone.
  3. Clear the cache: quit Teams and delete %appdata%\Microsoft\Teams (classic Teams) or reset the app (new Teams).
  4. Update audio drivers from Software Center.

short_description: Corporate Wi-Fi CORP-WIFI: connected but no Internet access
text:
Cause

Expired machine certificate, or the device is not in the NAC group.

Resolution

  1. Run 'gpupdate /force' and reboot.
  2. Check the certificate in certlm.msc > Personal.
  3. Forget the CORP-WIFI network and reconnect.
  4. If the certificate is missing, assign to the Network Team with hostname and MAC address.

short_description: BitLocker: recovery key requested at startup
text: Retrieve the key from Intune/Entra ID (Devices > [hostname] > BitLocker keys) using the Key ID shown on screen. Verify the user's identity before sharing the key. Common cause: BIOS update or a dock connected at boot.

short_description: OneDrive: sync stuck / red cross icon
text:
Resolution

  1. Check for file names with invalid characters or paths longer than 400 characters.
  2. Pause and resume syncing.
  3. Reset: '%localappdata%\Microsoft\OneDrive\onedrive.exe /reset'.
  4. Check the user's storage quota.

short_description: Slow laptop at startup / 100% CPU usage
text:
Resolution

  1. Task Manager > Startup: disable unnecessary apps.
  2. Check whether an antivirus scan or Windows Update is running.
  3. Run 'sfc /scannow' and 'DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /RestoreHealth'.
  4. Check disk health (SMART) with the vendor diagnostics.

short_description: Access denied to network shared folder
text: Share access is managed through AD groups 'FS_[Department]_RW/RO'. The user must submit a 'Shared folder access' catalog request approved by their manager. Once added to the group, the user must sign out and back in (or run 'klist purge').

short_description: Microsoft Authenticator MFA: new phone, notifications not received
text:
Resolution

  1. In Entra ID > Users > Authentication methods: 'Require re-register MFA'.
  2. Issue a Temporary Access Pass (valid 8 hours) after verifying the user's identity.
  3. The user registers the new phone at https://aka.ms/mysecurityinfo.

short_description: Excel crashes when opening large files
text:
Resolution

  1. Start 'excel.exe /safe' to rule out add-ins.
  2. Disable hardware graphics acceleration (File > Options > Advanced).
  3. Make sure 64-bit Office is used for files > 2GB.
  4. Run a Quick Repair of Office from Control Panel > Programs.
